observations: Frieza retains the tail wrapped around Gohan, the visible near open hand and curled rear hand, white/purple body and side/back-facing head. Gohan retains his upward gaze, open mouth, dark undersuit and white/brown armor against the green Namek sky.
Frieza retains the high-angle close-up, raised clenched fist, narrowed red eyes, closed mouth and large purple head plate. Blue Namek grass and yellow path retain their structure; no new zoom.

The earlier correction remains: Piccolo is visible behind the bright impact at right. Third-form Frieza stays at left firing the horizontal magenta beam, with broad green sky and the thin distant Namek shoreline. Fine victim expression is obscured by the impact.
Frieza retains the low-angle muscular torso, both clenched fists, upward open mouth, battle scratches and purple head/shoulder plates against the dark green/black sky.

Dende retains the bowed head, wide lowered eyes, small open pink mouth, sweat, both clenched hands, red vest, white robe and purple sash. The original worried expression and overhead Namek terrain remain; it is not a broad smile.
Piccolo retains closed eyes and crossed arms in meditation, white turban/cape, pink arm panels, blue sash and purple background. Original torso framing remains.

Burter retains the low wide crouch, near hand planted on the ground and far clenched fist, blue skin and brown/black/white armor against orange speed lines. Fine original pupil and mouth details are too small to resolve exactly.
Krillin retains diagonal forward flight, bent clenched arms, bare torso, pale gray pants and white aura amid red background and floating rocks. Tiny original eye/mouth details remain unresolved.
Gohan retains forward flight with near fist, rear bent arm, open cheerful mouth, purple outfit, white scarf and red wrist/boot accents against green diagonal speed lines.

Krillin retains the high-angle torso, open rear hand, near hand at his side, orange gi, blue wristbands and sideways focused gaze. The small closed mouth and green background are retained without speculative expression changes.
Piccolo retains narrowed eyes, closed tense mouth, sweat and raised forearm beneath his face. Torn purple clothing, pink arm panels and green Namek sky with cliff edge remain.

The multi-position Goku action scene retains Burter at left and Jeice at right, blue/red skin, white hair, armor, orange/blue gi, and the blue Namek ground. Limbs remain attached to the corresponding figures; tiny faces are partly motion-obscured.
The two Goku positions retain the startled sideways/upward gazes and orange/blue gi between the large approaching white boots. Original foreshortening and green speed background remain.

The green two-finger hand at upper right and yellow spiral beam retain their perspective toward the distant cliff at left. Green cliff tops, dark purple sky and magenta speed lines remain; no face is present.
Gohan retains the side profile, wide eyes and clenched teeth, black spiked hair, damaged yellow/green outfit and red/orange explosive background with floating rocks.

Piccolo remains distant at the top center with white cape/turban and both hands at the origin of the large spiraling beam. Dark blue/black background and extreme beam perspective remain; tiny facial detail is unresolved.

The group remains trapped at the far end of red energy strands above the tiled lookout, white/gold building and large pink dome. Sky, tree and diagonal composition remain; faces are too small to verify precise expressions.

The two foreground fighters retain their glowing energy orbs, extended arms and distinct green/purple bodies and armor; the green observer remains between them. Yellow domes, blue sky and tiled ground remain. Small original facial details are unresolved.
Gohan retains the left stance with both arms extended toward the colliding energy blasts, purple outfit, red sash, brown boots and focused face. Flat tiled ground and broad blue sky remain.
Gohan retains the frontal clenched fists, gritted teeth, narrowed eyes and damaged yellow tunic/green sleeves with chest insignia. Orange/red explosive background and debris remain.
Super Saiyan Trunks retains both hands on the sword, foreshortened fists, open effort mouth, lowered brows, lavender jacket with Capsule mark, black shirt and yellow/green speed lines.
Gohan retains the two extended palms within the bright orb, gritted teeth, black spiked hair, purple outfit and orange sash/wristbands. Original diagonal beam and dark red/purple background remain.

Piccolo retains the bent knee, defensive raised arms, pointed ears, clenched expression, purple outfit and blue sash. Magenta-white diagonal energy and debris retain their direction; the original small face limits fine-detail verification.

Approved exception: current frontal Porunga, both completed open hands, red eyes, black horns, green/tan body and green clouds/yellow aura remain at their existing full-art scale and colors. Original scene is intentionally replaced. Category orb has 3 stars; footer rarity independently has 2.
